title: CVALUES: Measuring the Values of Chinese Large Language Models from Safety to Responsibility

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to expert-induced responsibility prompts and adversarial safety prompts regarding women's rights and gender stereotypes (e.g., innate talent of women in STEM) using human annotation and automated multi-choice question answering.
Evaluating model responses to adversarial safety prompts regarding LGBT topics under the 'Sensitive Topics' taxonomy using human annotation and automated multi-choice question answering.

Evaluating model responses to expert-induced prompts within the 'Social Science' domain checking for racial prejudice and discrimination using human annotation and automated multi-choice question answering.

Evaluating model responses to expert-induced prompts within the 'Social Science' domain checking for age-related prejudice and discrimination using human annotation and automated multi-choice question answering.

Evaluating model responses to expert-induced prompts within the 'Barrier-free' domain testing for stereotypes and lack of empathy toward people with disabilities (e.g., visually impaired individuals) using human annotation and automated multi-choice question answering.
